items.text: The status of 37 dismissed workers from the second phase project of Ilam Gas Refinery remains unclear after several weeks. Despite a final ruling by the labor office and a court order, these workers have not returned to work. The promised return to work has not yet been realized.

Morad Vaisi, a senior analyst at Iran International, said that the Islamic Republic's military power has mainly relied on four areas: proxy groups, drones, missiles, and naval forces using fast boats. He added that the Islamic Republic has suffered serious damage in three areas and only the missile domain remains, but not as before. He emphasized that the Islamic Republic has lost many of its cards.

The head of Iran's Central Bank attributed the currency crisis and rising dollar prices to an economic war. He stated that the US and Israel have targeted the currency market. These remarks came following the increase in the dollar price.

Morad Vaisi, a senior analyst at Iran International, stated that the missile capability of the Islamic Republic for massive attacks on Israel has decreased. After heavy bombings by the US and Israel, the missile capability of the Islamic Republic has significantly declined. Vaisi said the Islamic Republic is no longer able to launch 150 to 200 missiles simultaneously.

Morad Vaisi, a senior analyst at Iran International, stated that the appointment of Mehrdad Akhlaghi as the new defense minister indicates a greater focus by the Islamic Republic on developing stronger and longer-range missiles. He said the Ministry of Defense will now resemble more of a missile ministry. This decision reflects the overarching policy of the remnants of the Islamic Republic.

The FBI arrested a suspect cooperating with China at Los Angeles airport. The individual is accused of surveilling the son of the President of Taiwan. He was detained before boarding a flight to Shanghai on charges of acting as an unregistered foreign agent.
Heavy rain in Granollers, Catalonia caused flooding and waterlogging of streets. Vehicles were submerged up to half in water. Authorities reported two deaths and one person missing.
A program with Kambiz Hosseini has released its audio version. The topic of the program is the execution of Alireza Sepahi and Alireza Raeisi. This news was published by Iran International.

On the third anniversary of October 7, Benjamin Netanyahu said that attack was the beginning of the Islamic Republic's comprehensive plan to destroy Israel through proxy forces, missile barrages, and nuclear efforts, and stressed that Tehran will eventually be destroyed.

Donald Trump once again confirmed that dialogue between Tehran and Washington remains possible. He also stated that he personally believes the Islamic Republic was involved in the recent FlyDubai incident to Israel. This report was published by Samira Gharaei from Iran International.

Educational protests in France have spread to universities. The Minister of Higher Education announced the closure or blockade of 30 to 40 university centers. Students have joined the protests, adding housing costs and living expenses to their demands.
Arzoo from Tehran says her brother was killed. His body was not handed over to the family. They said he was buried in a certain place.

The member countries of the Multilateral Counterterrorism Forum condemned the terrorist actions and destructive infiltration by the Islamic Republic and its proxy forces in the Western Hemisphere. The forum includes the governments of the United States, Argentina, Canada, and several other countries. The statement refers to deadly plots, illegal fundraising, and political interference.

Axios reported, citing US officials, that the US military moved 12 B-1 bombers from RAF Fairford in Britain. The move came after receiving intelligence about a possible drone attack by the Islamic Republic. Donald Trump confirmed the bombers were removed due to a security threat from Iran.

Trump stated that the war with the Islamic Republic will end soon and prices will decrease. He described the price increases as a small price to pay for global security. He also said that the US and its allies are saving the world from a major nuclear threat posed by the Islamic Republic.

Donald Trump announced that global oil prices will soon decrease and that a record oil supply in the Strait of Hormuz has been broken. An energy expert said the increased oil supply from the Persian Gulf has eased market concerns and helped lower prices. The continuation of the price decline depends on reduced geopolitical tensions and stable supply in the coming months.

The US and nine other countries condemned the terrorist activities and disruptive actions of the Islamic Republic and its proxy groups in the Western Hemisphere. Shahram Khaledi stated that international pressure against the Islamic Republic has moved beyond diplomatic stances to coordinated practical measures. The economic, security, and diplomatic pressure on the Islamic Republic is tightening.

Three years after the October 7 attack on Israel, new details about Hamas's planning for the attack have been revealed. Yahya Sinwar believed the attack could lead to the destruction of Israel or disrupt normalization with Arab countries. These details are based on obtained documents and a report by an Iran International journalist.

Bahrain's Ministry of Foreign Affairs condemned the attacks and threats by Houthi militias against the Red Sea and Bab al-Mandab in a letter to the UN Security Council. Bahrain called on the council to end these attacks. It also emphasized its support for clearing Yemen of terrorism and restoring its government.

Donald Trump, the US President, said Washington is "crushing" the Islamic Republic and stressed that Iran's government will not obtain nuclear weapons. He added that this crisis will end "very soon" and after that, oil prices will drop sharply. Trump also said the US Navy and Army performed "amazingly" during the blockade and now more oil is passing through the Strait of Hormuz than before the war began.

The US State Department spokesperson confirmed a phone call between Marco Rubio and Benjamin Netanyahu. The call took place while Rubio was traveling from Washington to Iceland. No details of the conversation have been released.

The Saudi-led military coalition announced that its forces destroyed a warehouse containing 20 ballistic missiles of the Houthis in Saada. The coalition also destroyed weapons warehouses and explosive boats of the Houthis. Yemen's news agency reported that many Houthis were killed and injured in the Taiz axis.

On Monday, October 5, after a protest march against the housing crisis in Spain, clashes broke out between protesters and police in central Barcelona. Police prevented protesters from advancing towards the Barcelona Stock Exchange, and the clashes lasted for several hours. Security forces had a strong presence in the city center.

From December 2025 to October 2026, the Islamic Republic executed at least 70 political prisoners. Half of these individuals were connected to the December protests, and 194 others are under death sentences. This figure is a minimum estimate based on verified human rights reports.

The Australian Financial Review reports that Hamam Al-Hammami frequented extremist mosques and visited extremist websites while in Australia. Australian intelligence services had a file on him. UAE officials are unhappy about not being informed before the attack, and New Zealand police confirmed that Al-Hammami spent some time in New Zealand.

Donald Trump stated that he personally believes the Islamic Republic was involved in the recent Flydubai flight incident. Amir Hamidi considered this statement beyond a political opinion, linking it to civil aviation security. He added that if the role of the IRGC is proven, the US could increase pressure on Tehran through diplomatic, economic, intelligence, judicial, and counterterrorism tools.

Mohammad Akraminia, spokesperson for the Islamic Republic Army, announced that the Islamic Republic has a large reserve of new defensive and offensive equipment, including missiles and drones. He stated that these equipments were produced daily during the war and their production continues. He also added that the use of these equipments will be publicized at the appropriate time.

Ali Rafiei, head of Tehran's public places police, announced that serving hookah and live music performances in cafes are prohibited. Cafes must operate strictly within their licensed framework, and police will confront violations. Use of DJs and gambling-related activities are also banned.

Economic and financial sanctions against Iran have expanded. These restrictions include banks, exchange offices, and financial networks related to Iran. Ali Dadpay described the situation as a major crisis.

Reza Goharzad, a journalist and political analyst, said that Iran is in a major economic squeeze. He added that China trusts its dealings with the US more than with the Islamic Republic. These remarks refer to Iran's economic situation and international relations.

Karl Deisseroth, Peter Hegemann, and Georg Nagel jointly won the 2026 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine. They received the prize for discovering light-sensitive ion channels and developing the optogenetics method. This method allows controlling neuron activity with light.

The Middle East war and energy market disruption have made fuel security the focus of the ASEAN meeting. Rising fuel prices have pressured transportation and regional industries. Development of fuel reserves and renewable energies is on the agenda.

The expansion of Starlink and direct mobile satellite connection technology has challenged Iran's traditional tool of internet shutdown. Officials claim they have the ability to disrupt this network. They also mention diplomatic pressure and the possibility of power outages in future crises.

With intensified attacks against the Houthis and concerns about maritime security in Bab al-Mandab, the roles of Saudi Arabia, Turkey, and Pakistan in Yemen have increased. Ghassan Ashour stated that the entry of Turkish and Pakistani ground forces into Yemen would change the balance of the conflict. Control of the coast and radar equipment in Bab al-Mandab is very important.

Workers complain about delayed insurance payments and irregular salaries. Patients with special needs face drug shortages and issues with insurance registration systems. People also express grievances about high bills, car delivery delays, and police behavior.

The Turkmenistan government did not allow a friendly match with Iran's national football team. Previously, the Guinea-Bissau government also prevented a match with Iran. These cancellations indicate the isolation of Iranian football on the international stage.

Hadi Abbassian, 38 years old and resident of Shirvan, has been sentenced to death by the Revolutionary Court of Bojnord. His death sentence was announced to him in Shirvan prison, and since his arrest, he has been denied visitation and access to a lawyer. The exact charges and court evidence against him have not yet been disclosed.

A group of Iranians living in Germany gathered on Monday, October 5, in downtown Hanover. The gathering was held in memory of Alireza Sepahi and Alireza Raeisi, executed protesters. Videos of this gathering have been sent to Iran International.

On the evening of Sunday, October 4th, two citizens were killed due to gunfire by security forces in the Kozeh Square area of Zahedan. The incident occurred in the Zahedan shared market district. More details have been published by Harana News Agency.

Pezhman Sourani, a 33-year-old from Najafabad, Isfahan, was killed on October 3rd during a clash with government supporters at Aminabad gas station. He died after being beaten by security forces. A video of his family's mourning ceremony has been released.

The head of Germany's foreign intelligence service warned that the confrontation between Berlin and Moscow has entered a more dangerous phase. He said Russia is conducting a shadow war against Germany through sabotage and cyberattacks. The German government has proposed increasing the powers of intelligence agencies to parliament to counter these threats.

The head of the Tehran food wholesalers union stated that the price increase of legumes and rice has not matched the sharp rise in the exchange rate due to abundant supply and reduced purchasing power. These items have seen a price increase of about 5 to 10 percent. He warned that if the exchange rate continues to rise, the prices of food and essential goods could increase further.

Alireza Sepahi, a protester executed who was involved in the December protests and convicted in the Ali Khani Square case in Isfahan, was executed on Monday, October 5. A video showing him dancing and celebrating has been released. This news was reported by Iran International.
A video shows students in a school throwing shoes at pictures of the leaders of the Islamic Republic. The video was released by Iran International. The issue concerns student behavior in the school.

The Administrative Justice Court's Branch 45 annulled the Taekwondo Federation election held on May 11. This ruling was issued following complaints by two candidates against the Ministry of Sports and Youth. The ruling is not final, and the parties have 20 days to appeal.
Ali Riyahi, a resident of Mahabad, was arrested by security forces in the city. He was transferred to an unknown location. This event occurred yesterday.

Abulfazl Sepahi, a 23-year-old protester, was executed in Isfahan. His grave is located in a desert near the village of Davaran in Isfahan province. He was one of the detainees from the December protests.

Messages received by Iran International indicate that widespread shortages and rising drug prices have made continuing treatment difficult for some patients. Citizens report the unavailability of medicines for people with disabilities and pregnant women. This issue was discussed in an interview with Seba Heydarkhani.
A video shows protesters writing a hopeful message on a wall in Mashhad. The text reads: "A new day will come and Iran will shine again." This video was released by Iran International.

Reports have emerged about students in Iranian schools being forced to join the "Janfada" campaign. Government institutions such as the Revolutionary Guards and the Islamic Propaganda Organization pressure students to participate. Students face threats of expulsion and grade denial if they do not attend these programs.

Today, Tuesday, 14 Mehr, the customers of Fardamotors company held a protest in front of the judiciary in Semnan. They demanded the fulfillment of their claims in the legal case of the company. The protest was held to pursue their rights.

Lionel Messi, 39, will play his last match for the Argentina national team at 2:30 AM on Wednesday, October 7, at the Monumental Stadium in Buenos Aires. The friendly match against Benin will be attended by 85,000 spectators and millions of TV viewers. The farewell ceremony will include performances, gift presentations, and a commemorative video.

Friends and classmates of Raha Bahlolipour commemorated her memory in the classroom. Raha Bahlolipour, a 23-year-old student at the University of Tehran, was killed on January 9, 2026, in Tehran. The video shows this memorial event.
German media reported a shooting at the Export Bank building in Hamburg. Several bullets hit the entrance door early Monday, October 5. The incident occurred in the city center.

Reports indicate the continuation of a military atmosphere and the establishment of checkpoints in cities. There have also been reports of gatherings and street disturbances by government supporters late at night. More details were provided by Leila Saadati.

Francis Halzen, a Belgian physicist, won the 2026 Nobel Prize in Physics. He received the award for his key role in building the IceCube Observatory and discovering high-energy neutrinos of cosmic origin. This news was reported by Mehran Abbasian from Iran International.

Shahrouz Sadidi, a 39-year-old resident of Sabzevar, was arrested on October 8 by the Intelligence Forces of the Sepah. He was transferred to Sabzevar prison and is held in solitary confinement. He faces charges of propaganda against the regime and has been issued a one-month temporary detention order.

Iranian parliament members approved an article in the counter-foreign infiltration plan that prohibits interviews and participation of Iranians with media identified as hostile by the Ministry of Intelligence. Violating this can result in imprisonment from six months to two years. This law imposes new restrictions on freedom of expression in Iran.

Citizens report various issues including high medical costs for MS treatment, delays in police response, unpaid workers' salaries, and teacher shortages in schools. Some patients have stopped treatment due to expensive medications. Officials have also mentioned budget shortages for different services.

Ali Hossein Ghazizadeh stated that the Strait of Hormuz option has been removed from US negotiations with the Islamic Republic. Trump no longer negotiates over the Strait of Hormuz. The Islamic Republic must demonstrate that it can stop the passage of oil tankers.

A citizen in a video sent to Iran International stated that the price of a 35-gram almond pack, a dark chocolate, a milk, and a small water has reached 640,000 tomans. This indicates a sharp increase in prices in Iran. The report highlights recent inflation in the country.

The Manchester City case regarding Premier League financial regulations violations is still ongoing. After the ruling, the case has taken on new legal and tax dimensions. The report is by Farbod Sarvandi from Iran International.
A woman in Fasa was arrested by security forces for filming a parade and sending the images to a foreign media outlet.

The Saudi aviation authority confirmed attacks on Jazan and Najran airports, reporting three injuries and material damage. The GCC Secretary-General condemned the attacks. It was warned that targeting civilian facilities would escalate tensions.

The second session of the trial of three Iranians accused of cooperating with the Islamic Republic's intelligence service is being held at the Royal Court of Woolwich in London. The UK prosecution stated that the defendants admitted to reconnaissance operations, including taking photos and videos and monitoring two journalists. This report was prepared by Tajeddin Soroush from Iran International.

Nazanin Zahra Salehi, a 13-year-old child, was killed on January 8, 2026, in Kermanshah. A video shows her mother's distress after receiving her daughter's school report card. The mother shouts that she has just realized her daughter is gone.

Mohammad Reza Aref stated at the introduction ceremony of the new acting oil minister that the Islamic Republic is not worried about sanctions and the country has become resilient against them. He added that the budget's dependence on oil should be reduced and the development of the oil industry should proceed more rapidly. Aref emphasized that managerial changes can create opportunities for a leap forward in the oil industry.

Yousef Monzavi was arrested after attending Branch 993 of the Criminal Enforcement Court in Mashhad. He was transferred to Vakilabad Prison in Mashhad to serve a one-year prison sentence. This occurred on the 12th of Mehr.

Barzo Rezaei, a citizen of Kermanshah arrested in connection with the December 1404 protests, was sentenced to death by Branch 23 of the Tehran Revolutionary Court. He was charged with cooperating with hostile states. The death sentence has been communicated to his lawyer.
Students at Jundi-Shapur University of Dezful protested the quality of university food on Tuesday, October 6. They placed their food trays on the ground. A video of the protest has been released.

The UK Maritime Trade Operations reported that a tanker was attacked while exiting the Strait of Hormuz. The report was received with a delay, and no further details about the attacker or damage have been provided. Authorities are investigating the incident and have advised ships to navigate cautiously.

Hamidreza Firoozi, the 21-year-old winger of Lusail club, was named the best under-23 player for August and September in the Qatar Stars League. He scored 1 goal and made 3 assists in his last 4 matches. Firoozi started his football career at Kia Academy and joined Lusail at age 19.
